hypothesis: Among eligible closed scored customers in the competition data, adding customer profile and same-product Jan-Apr usage improves held-out low-CSAT identification over ticket metadata alone.
outcome: Customer Satisfaction Rating <= 2; ratings 3-5 are the other class
per_customer_ticket: lowest numeric Ticket ID among eligible closed rated tickets
usage_features: Jan-Apr means and Apr-minus-Jan differences; Active Days normalized by calendar month, other values log1p before aggregating
selection_metric: development Brier score, ties prefer larger l2
primary_metric: test mean squared probability error (Brier); lower is better
exploratory_gate: both test classes present; gain >= 0.02; paired bootstrap 95% gain lower bound > 0; full-context Brier < training-prevalence Brier
secondary_metrics: observed low ratings among top-5 ranked held-out cases
prohibited_interpretation: No advance warning, causal effect, improved customer resolution, or generalization outside selected closed scored customers. N=20 is exploratory even if the gate passes.
